title: Stale or interrupted unlock operation recovery
reproduction: An unlock operation begins via unlock_started, but the async provider is interrupted, hangs, or the UI closes without calling cancelUnlock. Subsequent beginUnlock calls are permanently rejected as already_pending.
proposedRemediation: Track unlockStartedAt on the session snapshot. In admitUnlockAttempt, if state is unlock_pending and Date.parse(at) - Date.parse(unlockStartedAt) > UNLOCK_OPERATION_TIMEOUT_MS (30s), allow a new attempt to supersede the stale pending operation and reset state cleanly.

title: Cooldown counter reset on elapsed cooldown window
reproduction: After 5 failed passphrase attempts, cooldownUntil is set for 60s. After waiting 60s, a subsequent attempt with a single typo immediately re-triggered another 60s cooldown because failedAttempts remained at 5.
proposedRemediation: In unlock_started, if cooldownUntil is in the past, reset failedAttempts to 0 and clear cooldownUntil to null for the new attempt cycle.

title: Mobile push notification privacy exclusion for vault destinations
reproduction: A local reminder scheduled with destination: 'vault' or targetType: 'vault' would expose title/details if privacyLevel was accidentally omitted.
proposedRemediation: Explicitly check options.destination === 'vault' and targetType === 'vault' alongside journal in scheduleLocalReminderAsync, unconditionally forcing generic title and placeholder body regardless of user mode.

title: Biometric invalidation fallback guidance message
reproduction: Biometric enrollment change invalidates Keystore key. Controller locks, but user was not given explicit actionable copy that biometrics cannot be retried and primary passphrase/recovery key is required.
proposedRemediation: Ensure biometric_invalidated failure responses return explicit guidance: 'Biometric enrollment changed; device key invalidated. Use passphrase.'

title: Cross-tab lock synchronization on backgrounding
reproduction: When one tab transitions to hidden, background lock occurred locally, but if other tabs remained visible, they were not immediately locked via broadcast signal unless explicit lock was requested.
proposedRemediation: Broadcast lock_signal with reason 'background' across BroadcastChannel when visibility transitions to hidden, ensuring all open tabs lock immediately without transmitting secrets.

title: Strict recovery secret canonicalization & error differentiation
reproduction: verifyAndDecodeRecoverySecret returned generic error messages on corrupted checksum vs formatting errors.
proposedRemediation: Differentiate transcription checksum failure ('Recovery secret checksum validation failed') from formatting errors (odd length, non-hex characters, invalid length).

title: Large attachment streaming format unfinalized
reproduction: Large file encryption requires chunked streaming AEAD. Homegrown protocols are prohibited; proposed libsodium secretstream has not undergone external audit.
proposedRemediation: Keep single-envelope AES-256-GCM for <= 16 MiB objects; keep streaming format proposed-only pending independent review. Keep production attachment encryption gated.
disposition: Documented gate limitation; production attachments remain gated.

title: Independent qualified external audit and physical Android device evidence unmet
reproduction: No independent external security auditor has reviewed the vault implementation packet, and physical Android phone hardware evidence is uncollected in local runner.
proposedRemediation: Prepare complete review packet (docs/engineering/vault-security-review-packet.md), retain fail-closed gate, truthfully record Phase 86 status as blocked with DEF-V2-004 retained.
disposition: Documented release gate; blocks production vault enablement.
